# Xorder restaurant workspace

This hostname is one restaurant's Xorder workspace. Everything here except the
public menu is a private, authenticated dashboard — there is no public content on
this host worth crawling or training on.

## What is public here

- [The restaurant's menu](/menu/): the QR-code destination diners see, served
  server-rendered with the restaurant's name, description, image and schema.org
  Restaurant data in the HTML.

## What is not

- Every other path on this host is the restaurant's dashboard (orders, menu
  editing, branches, staff, analytics). It requires a login and returns no data
  without one.

## About the platform

- [Xorder](https://xorder.io/): the product behind this workspace
- [Sitemap of all public menus](https://xorder.io/sitemap.xml)
